THE LAND ACQUISITION ACT (CHAPTER 460)
Declaration under Section 5

I, John Anthony Emmanuel Amarathunga, Minister of Lands herebydeclare under Sub section (1) of Section 5 of the Land AcquisitionAct, that the land described below is needed for a public purposeand will be acquired under the provisions of that Act.

An allotment of land called Werugodella containing in extent 0.8930Hectare depicted in Surveyor General’s Advance Tracing No. MA/SG/2013/394 dated 15.02.2013 situated at Thalagoda (a portion) (withinFVP 535) village in Gangala Pallesiya pattuwa minor Division of NaulaDivisional Secretary’s Division, Matale District, Central Province andbounded as follows :

01. Lot ‘A’ – Werugodella – Extent: 0.8930 HectareNorth: Ela and Werugodella land claimed by R. M. A. G. JayanthaKumara Rathnayake; East: Werugodella land claimed by R. M. A. G.Jayantha Kumara Rathnayake and road (PS); South: Road (PS) andWerugodela land claimed by H. M. G. Wijerathne; West: Ela.
